The Worthiness Guardian is not a mindless sentinel—it is a deliberate judge, tasked with determining whether intruders are worthy of what lies beyond. Unlike guardians that simply attack all trespassers, this being engages adventurers in conversation, poses moral dilemmas, and watches their reactions to determine if they possess the character traits required to proceed.

The Guardian may test courage, compassion, wisdom, or cunning depending on what it protects. It has observed countless adventurers over the centuries and can distinguish genuine heroism from mere bravado. Those who pass its test may receive aid, information, or safe passage. Those who fail may be turned away, offered false guidance, or destroyed if they prove actively malevolent.

**Motivations:**
- Protect what they guard from the unworthy
- Seek individuals who embody the virtues their charge represents
- Maintain the balance between access and security

**Roleplaying Tips:**
- Asks probing questions that reveal character, not just knowledge
- May present hypothetical scenarios to gauge moral reasoning
- Shows respect to those who demonstrate genuine virtue, regardless of power
